name: CXiSkeletonActor_AnimateModels
summary: Walks the actor's model list (sub_1002B5A0) calling Model_AnimateAndPose on each; if all succeed sets flags(+0x30)|=0x12 and returns 1, else 0.
evidence: Loop over null-terminated model list; flag OR 0x12 at this+48; callers PerActor_FourBucketStaggeredUpdate and sub_1002B6E0. DancingMad 'Model_AnimateEntry' agrees on purpose but says 'unconditionally'; code actually iterates all models and stops on first failure.

name: CXiSkeletonActor_PrepareModelsOnce
summary: Once per update (guarded by flag 4 at this+48) calls sub_1002A3B0 on every model in the actor's list, then resets texture stage 1 TEXTURETRANSFORMFLAGS/TEXCOORDINDEX to 0.
evidence: Flag test/set 4 at this+48; SetTextureStageState(1, D3DTSS_TEXTURETRANSFORMFLAGS,0) and (1,D3DTSS_TEXCOORDINDEX,0); recon file CXiSkeletonActor.cpp; sub_1002A3B0 itself acquires VBs/textures so it is a per-model prep/draw step.

name: CXiSkeletonActor_GetElemThunk

evidence: Single-call body returning sub_1002C400(this,a3,a4,a5); callers CXiSkeletonActor_GetElem and GetElemLocal.

name: CXiSkeletonActor_GetModelEidMatrix

name: List_GetTail

name: Mem_AllocDefault
summary: Allocates a1 bytes via sub_10028FD0 with fixed pool/flag argument 4.

name: CYyOs2VtxBuffer_CreateBuffersStep
summary: Incremental state machine (state at this+60) that allocates a 0xFFFF-filled index shadow, creates a D3D INDEX16 index buffer, then acquires a pooled vertex buffer; on failure frees everything. Returns 1 when finished.
evidence: switch(this[15]); CreateIndexBuffer(2*n, D3DUSAGE_WRITEONLY(8), D3DFMT_INDEX16, D3DPOOL_DEFAULT); CYyVbMng acquire (sub_1003B210) of 8*n+4 bytes FVF 0x208; release via vtable+8 and sub_1003B3C0 on error.

name: CYyOs2VtxBuffer_Constructor
summary: Calls base ctor, stores CYyOs2VtxBuffer_vtbl, zeroes buffer fields and creates the vertex shader from g_vsDecl_1628.
evidence: *this=&CYyOs2VtxBuffer_vtbl; returns this; CreateVertexShader(&g_vsDecl_1628, NULL, this+100, 0).

name: CYyOs2VtxBuffer_Destructor
summary: Restores the vtable, frees the index shadow, releases the index buffer and pooled VB, deletes the vertex shader, frees other heap blocks, removes itself from a 16-slot global table and calls the base dtor.
evidence: *this=&CYyOs2VtxBuffer_vtbl; Release via vtable+8; DeleteVertexShader(this+100); dword_1045B650[16] slot cleared; sole caller CYyOs2VtxBuffer_ScalarDeletingDtor.

name: CYyModelDt_SkinAndDrawV2
summary: Locks the model's position/normal VBs (Sleep(0) retry), runs CPU skinning (sub_1002F1D0), unlocks, then sets texture-factor/stage state and walks the model's command stream issuing SetStreamSource/SetIndices/DrawIndexedPrimitive per material.
evidence: VB Lock vtable+0x2C / Unlock +0x30 loops; D3DRS_TEXTUREFACTOR, stage-1 MODULATE TFACTOR ops; command words (0x5453 etc.) dispatching CDx_DrawIndexedPrimitive and CDx_SetLight. DancingMad calls it CYyModelDt_PrepareRenderStateV2 and the recon file uses that name; the code agrees with the skinning start DM describes but also performs the draws, so a draw-oriented name fits better.

name: Gfx_SetStreamSourceCached

evidence: dword_1045B690[a1]=vb; dword_10457554[a1]=stride; calls sub_1002F160 which does SetStreamSource.

name: Model_SkinVerticesCpu
summary: Software skinning: for each single-bone and two-bone-weighted vertex group, transforms positions/normals by bone matrices from the bone table (64-byte stride) into the locked VB pointers; separate path when model flag bit 0 is set.
evidence: Called only from the CYyModelDt draw (sub_1002DC10) between VB Lock and Unlock; uses dword_10457550 (g_boneWeightMatrixTable) + (bone<<6); counts from dword_1045B618 low/high words; helpers sub_100309B0 (1 bone), sub_10030A40 (2 bones); CPU-feature gate sub_1000D680/D6B0.

name: Model_BeginOffscreenPass
summary: When the effect mode is active and a render target exists, saves two texture pointers and a texture factor, pushes this+8 as render target (clearing on first use), sets flat constant-color unlit/no-Z state and a narrow 11.25-degree perspective projection plus view/world transforms.
evidence: CDx_PushRenderTarget, CDx_EndClearBegin once (flag this+4); TEXTUREFACTOR 0x80FFFFFF, COLOROP SELECTARG2/TFACTOR; LIGHTING/FOG/ZENABLE/ZWRITE off; D3DXMatrixPerspectiveFovLH(0.19635,1,0.1,65535). Purpose (e.g. projected shadow) not confirmed.

summary: Sets stage 0/1 blend ops (variant chosen by a2 in 1..2), restores the saved texture factor and, in the offscreen mode, the scene transforms and Z/fog/lighting states, then binds the two textures saved by the begin call to stages 0 and 1.
evidence: Pairs with sub_10033800 (same globals dword_1045B800/804, g_texturefactor_B808, word_1045B77A, flt_1045B80C<4.0); SetTransform(PROJECTION/VIEW/WORLD) from g_matrix_*; ZENABLE/ZWRITE/FOG/LIGHTING=1; SetTexture(0/1, tex+64 or tex+68).

evidence: Rate sub_10014CF0()*0.04 clamped to 1; atan2/sin(1.0471976=60deg) clamp; called per actor from PerActor_FourBucketStaggeredUpdate; same unit as the offscreen-pass functions. 'Shadow' area is inferred.
